name: 3D Transfer Function
aliases: TF based on value, gradient magnitude, and second directional derivative
Transfer function using gradient magnitude and second directional derivative
definition: A transfer function that uses three dimensions to map volume data to visual properties: scalar data value, gradient magnitude, and second directional derivative along the gradient direction. It solves the problem of disambiguating complex boundary configurations where material boundaries overlap in data value and gradient magnitude but differ in second derivative.
summary: The 3D Transfer Function maps volume data to visual properties using scalar value, gradient magnitude, and second directional derivative to disambiguate materials with similar values and gradients but different boundary curvature.
